fullDesc:
Find your perfect Ubud escape at Villa St. Lau, a private sanctuary hidden in tropical greenery just minutes from Ubud’s heart.

Unwind in open living spaces, cool off in a sparkling pool, soak in the outdoor bathtub, or enjoy sunset BBQs and friendly billiard matches under the stars.

With full amenities and caring staff, Villa St. Lau is where you can slow down, reconnect, and let Bali cast its spell.

THE SPACE
Step into your private sanctuary at St. Lau; a villa designed for slow mornings, sun-drenched afternoons and dreamy Bali nights. Slide open the doors to a sparkling pool wrapped in lush gardens and enjoy thoughtful amenities at every turn.

Inside, bright pavilions host a cozy lounge with TV and billiard table, plus a fully equipped kitchen and dining area for lazy breakfasts or fresh juices after a day out. Fire up the BBQ for a fun evening with friends, or if you’d rather not cook, we can arrange meals for you or point you to Ubud’s best cafés.

The bedrooms are private and tranquil, with soft linens on king beds that can be converted to twins on request, TVs, en-suite bathrooms and calming views of the surrounding greenery, perfect for both parents and kids. Two of the bathrooms share an outdoor bathtub and shower, ideal for a relaxing soak or a playful starlit bath time with little ones.

With daily cleaning included, all that’s left is to slow down, reconnect, and let Bali work its magic.

GUEST ACCESS
Guests will be able to access the entire villa and have full privacy.

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Villa staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guests
- Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request 
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool Fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

name: Iconic 5BR Cliff Top Villa with 180° Ocean View

reviews.name: Domenic
reviews.comment: The view is truly stunning, the private beach access is lovely, and breakfast at the resort restaurant is convenient and delicious. Unfortunately, numerous shortcomings marred the stay: check-in was delayed (3 p.m. instead of 2 p.m.), there were stains on the bed and sun loungers, the rain shower did not work properly, the oven was unusable, the pool pump had to be activated manually, the water dispenser was hygienically questionable, and the refrigerator was dirty. The main bathroom upstairs flooded. There is no window, just an open recess, which makes it extremely hot. The house looks like it needs renovating. The outdoor wooden floor is outdated, with holes and nails (risk of injury). The villa is located in the middle of a resort. Arrival was confusing, and the manager was not very motivated. No Uber/taxi pick-ups allowed in front of the resort. Not enough coffee capsules (10/day) for the whole group. The cleaning staff were friendly, but had to stay for 3 hours according to the instructions. Unfortunately, the value for money is not right. We cannot recommend the villa.
reviews.originalComment: Die Aussicht ist wirklich grandios, der private Strandzugang schön und das Frühstück im Resort-Restaurant praktisch und lecker. Leider trüben zahlreiche Mängel den Aufenthalt: Check-in verspätet (15 statt 14 Uhr), Flecken auf Bett und Sonnenliegen, Regendusche funktionierte nicht richtig, Backofen nicht nutzbar, Poolpumpe musste manuell aktiviert werden, Wasserspender hygienisch fragwürdig, Kühlschrank verschmutzt. Im Hauptbad oben kam es zu Überflutungen, es gibt kein Fenster, nur eine offene Aussparung, dadurch extrem warm. Haus wirkt renovierungsbedürftig, Außenholzboden veraltet mit Löchern und Nägeln (Verletzungsgefahr). Die Villa liegt mitten in einem Resort, Ankunft war verwirrend, Manager wenig motiviert. Vor dem Resort keine Grab-/Taxi-Abfahrt erlaubt. Kaffeekapseln (10/Tag) für die ganze Gruppe zu wenig. Reinigungspersonal freundlich, musste aber laut Vorgabe 3 Stunden bleiben. Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis passt leider nicht, können die Villa nicht empfehlen.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Domenic, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re pleased to hear you enjoyed the magnificent views, private beach access, and the convenience of having the resort and restaurant nearby.
Just to clarify, the standard check-in time is 2 PM. As you arrived earlier, the villa was still being prepared. Luggage can be dropped off from 12 PM, but the villa may not yet be ready as the housekeeping team needs sufficient time to prepare it properly.
Regarding the other concerns mentioned, unfortunately, none were raised during your stay. Had they been brought to our attention, the team would have been happy to check and assist where possible. Following your feedback, the items mentioned have been checked and are currently in good condition.
As the villa is located within a resort, certain resort-wide policies apply, including arrangements for online transportation and guest pick-ups, which we kindly ask guests to respect. The villa also provides 10 coffee pods per day for up to 10 guests; this is the standard daily provision and is not unlimited.
Thank you again for your feedback. We’ll continue to maintain the villa carefully and work to provide a good quality experience for our guests.

reviews.name: Leilana
reviews.comment:

This makes it convenient if you want to eat at the restaurant (no other restaurants are close by), but that is the extent because Biu Biu won’t help you. I had conflicting information regarding using their shuttle bus to the beach - we were informed we could not use it, but another person at a sister property told us we could use it. 
The upstairs master has open windows (no glass), so it’s constantly warm and you need to keep the doors close if you want the a/c to work.
The hot water was inconsistent at best with a max of 5 minutes before going cold. 
The people who managed the property were nice but only responsive during certain hours of the day, which makes it difficult if something came up in the evening. 
Not worth the money. We would not stay here again.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hello Leilana, we’re sorry to hear that your stay did not fully meet your expectations. While guests may enjoy the convenience of the nearby restaurant and beachfront surroundings, we would like to clarify that the villa is independently managed and is not operated by Biu Biu. Therefore, their services, facilities, and access policies may differ from those of the villa. All available facilities and services included with your stay are communicated by our team, and we kindly recommend referring to the information provided by our team, as policies at other properties may not apply to our villa.
The upstairs master bedroom is also shown clearly in the listing photos. As with any air-conditioned room, especially in a tropical climate, keeping doors and windows closed while using the air conditioning is necessary to maintain a comfortable temperature. Regarding the hot water, our team inspected the system and confirmed that it was functioning properly during the stay. We would have been happy to investigate further had we been informed of any issues while you were at the villa.
Regarding communication, during nighttime hours, responses may occasionally take longer, but our contact number and Airbnb messaging remain available, and we always do our best to respond as quickly as possible whenever assistance is needed.
Thank you again for sharing your feedback. We value guest comments as they help us continue improving our service. At the same time, we kindly encourage guests to review the villa details, facilities, and tropical setting carefully before booking to ensure expectations are aligned with the experience we provide. description: Embark on an exquisite 5-Bedroom Cliff-Top Villa with Breathtaking Views, a spacious haven perched on a cliff in the Balangan area.
fullDesc:
Embark on an exquisite 5-Bedroom Cliff-Top Villa with Breathtaking Views, a spacious haven perched on a cliff in the Balangan area.

What to expect :
- Exclusive access to the private beach of the Biu Biu complex
- Modern and elegant design
- Unobstructed sea views and spacious pool overlooking the cliff

The villa is fully equipped and staffed so you don't have to worry about a thing!

THE SPACE
Welcome to our villa, an exquisite cliff-top retreat in the breathtaking Balangan area. 
With 5 bedrooms, including 2 upstairs bedrooms with en suite bathrooms, this villa promises a luxurious escape for you.

Step inside to discover a private kitchen attached to a charming dining area, perfect for enjoying delicious meals with loved ones. 
The semi-open living area seamlessly connects to the inviting pool area, where you can soak up the sun and take in the breathtaking ocean views.

Relax and unwind in the spacious 10 x 5-meter swimming pool, surrounded by lush greenery and overlooking the azure waters of the Indian Ocean.

Additionally, the villa offers a patio with ocean views, providing the ideal spot for enjoying a morning coffee or evening cocktail while soaking in the beauty of the surroundings.

As a guest of the villa, you'll enjoy exclusive access to the private beach of the Biu Biu complex, where you can unwind on the secluded shores and immerse yourself in the natural beauty of Bali's coastline.

Experience the ultimate in luxury and relaxation at our villa, where every detail is designed to ensure an unforgettable stay.

GUEST ACCESS
The whole villa will be available for you with complete privacy.

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE
Included in every stay:
• Free welcome drink
• Villa’s staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
• Bath & Pool towels for each guests
• Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
• Safety box
• Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:
• Airport transfer
• Car rental (with/without driver)
• Bike rental
• Breakfast upon request
• Private cook
• Massages at the villa
• Nanny services
• Pool fence
• Laundry
• Restaurant bookings
• Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
• Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
• And much more! 

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

description: Discover Villa Angkasa, a breathtaking retreat in Ubud, where modern comforts meet Bali’s natural charm.
fullDesc:
Discover Villa Angkasa, a breathtaking retreat in Ubud, where modern comforts meet Bali’s natural charm.

What you’ll love:

- Stylish, high-end interiors designed for comfort and elegance
- Prime location, just minutes from Monkey Forest, Ubud Center, The Blanco Renaissance Museum, and more!
- Expansive pool with a tasteful patio, perfect for soaking in the blue sky and lush surroundings

Fully equipped and staffed, Villa Angkasa lets you unwind and make the most of your Bali getaway.

THE SPACE
Nestled in the heart of Ubud, Villa Angkasa is a stylish 5-bedroom sanctuary where modern luxury meets Bali’s natural beauty. This spacious retreat is perfect for families or friends seeking a private escape surrounded by lush landscapes, yet just minutes from Ubud’s vibrant center.

Designed for tranquility and comfort, the villa centers around a sparkling infinity pool and generous outdoor spaces. Sleek modern lines and natural textures complement open-air living areas, while shaded lounges and garden pathways invite slow, relaxed moments.

Unwind by the infinity pool, stretch out on sun-kissed daybeds, or relax beneath gently swaying umbrellas. Floor-to-ceiling glass doors in every suite create a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living, framing beautiful views of the surrounding greenery and rice fields.

Inside, five beautifully appointed ensuite bedrooms blend comfort with contemporary style, each featuring plush king-size beds, smart TVs, and sleek private bathrooms. The master bedroom also features a relaxing bathtub, perfect for unwinding after a day exploring Ubud.

At the heart of the villa is the open-plan living area, styled with sculptural furnishings, warm wood accents, and earthy tones. Filled with natural light, the space flows effortlessly into a fully equipped modern kitchen—ideal for casual breakfasts or relaxed evening meals. For deeper relaxation, indulge in a soothing in-villa massage while surrounded by peaceful tropical scenery.

With thoughtful design, full amenities, and a prime Ubud location, Villa Angkasa offers more than just a stay, it’s an experience for a memorable Bali escape.

GUEST ACCESS
Complete access and total privacy.

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Daily housekeeping
- Bath towels for each guests

- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Discover Villa Habitas, a brand new four bedroom stunning villa nestled within a serene landscape in Pererenan.

This architectural masterpiece seamlessly blends minimalistic design with luxury amenities, providing a tranquil escape for those seeking refined aesthetics and functionality.

What to expect:
- High quality furnishing
- Close to the beach and all the best cafes and restaurants
- Contemporary & minimalistic design

Our villa is fully equipped and staffed for your comfort.

THE SPACE
Upon entering the property, you're welcomed by an impressive, grand spiral staircase situated at the heart of a spacious living area.

This living space features a spacious and cozy seating area, complete with a TV equipped with Netflix for those rainy days. Its decor is Mediterranean-inspired, emphasizing a minimalist and sleek design.

Adjacent to the living room is a massive wooden dining table, perfect for savoring the delicacies of the Balinese cuisine.

A fully-equipped kitchen is also on hand for preparing any meal, or you can opt to have someone cook for you. Please inform us if you'd like to arrange a dinner with an in-home chef!

One of the highlight of Villa Habitas is its outdoor area. Boasting a lagoon-shaped, crystal clear pool, it's the ideal spot to bask in the Balinese sunshine! Adjacent to this pool is a spacious sunken lounge, an ideal setting for group gatherings and enjoying a drink for sunset.
The outdoor area also boasts several sunbeds scattered around the pool as well as another dining table, allowing for breakfast, lunch, or dinner in an outdoor setting.
Villa Habitas also features a spacious garden area.

The villa offers an unobstructed view of rice fields, providing the real Balinese experience.

Every bedroom at Villa Habitas comes with an en-suite bathroom, spacious closets featuring a safety box, and a king-sized bed. Of the four bedrooms in Villa Habitas, one is situated on the ground floor, while the other three, including the master bedroom with an added bathtub, are on the first floor.

Villa Habitas also enjoys large parking spaces which can accomodate up to 2 cars and scooters. It is located in a quiet street of Pererenan and trendy cafes, restaurants and bars are at walking distance of the villa.
You can be at the Pererenan beach and in the center of canggu in a short drive.

Our villa is fully equipped and manned by a team of committed professionals, eager to ensure your stay is truly memorable.

description: Welcome to Villa Solani, a cozy 1-bedroom villa nestled in the heart of Pererenan. Just 8 minutes from the beach by scooter, this tropical escape is ideal for those craving comfort, privacy, and a slower pace.
fullDesc:
Welcome to Villa Solani, a cozy 1-bedroom villa nestled in the heart of Pererenan. Just 8 minutes from the beach by scooter, this tropical escape is ideal for those craving comfort, privacy, and a slower pace.

Surrounded by greenery, the villa offers a private pool, open-plan living, and calming natural finishes throughout. 

A perfect hideaway for couples or solo travelers, Villa Solani is your serene home base in one of Bali’s most laid-back corners.

THE SPACE
This tropical 1BR villa combines modern design with lush surroundings. Warm wood accents, cascading greenery, and an open-plan layout create a seamless flow from indoors to the private pool. Perfect for slow mornings and laid-back afternoons in the heart of Pererenan.

Inside, the villa features a warm, open-plan layout with a sunken lounge, built-in seating, and soft neutral tones that create a cozy yet refined feel. Floor-to-ceiling glass doors flood the space with natural light and open to lush garden views, while the fully equipped kitchen with rich makes it easy to enjoy anything from home-cooked meals to casual drinks. For added convenience, a semi-outdoor bathroom is located just beside the kitchen—perfect for a quick rinse after a swim.

The bedroom is a serene escape, featuring a king-sized bed, soft natural tones, and views of tropical greenery through sliding glass doors. Thoughtfully designed for comfort, it includes an ensuite bathroom, smart TV, and thoughtful touches throughout, it’s designed for restful nights and slow, sunny mornings.

Daily cleaning is included, so you can fully unwind without lifting a finger. Whether you're here to surf, explore, or simply relax by the pool, we’ve got you covered.

Book your stay and make your Bali getaway truly unforgettable.

GUEST ACCESS
Full privacy and reserved for guests.

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Villa staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guests
- Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny Services
- Pool Fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more! 

Please note : The stairs in the villa are slightly steep. Most guests have no issue, but they may not be suitable for those with mobility concerns or very young children. Please take care when using them.

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

description: Searching for the ideal accommodation in Canggu?
fullDesc:
Searching for the ideal accommodation in Canggu? 

Casa Kameelya is a brand-new villa with four bedrooms, conveniently situated within walking distance to the beach and popular cafes, bars, and restaurants. 

With its high ceiling, expansive windows, and a design that blends modern amenities with Mediterranean accents, Casa Kameelya is an excellent choice for large families or group. 

The villa is fully staffed and equipped, ensuring you can relax and enjoy your stay without any concerns.

THE SPACE
Casa Kameelya is a brand-new, stylish villa featuring four bedrooms—three with king-size beds and one with twin beds—each equipped with a private bathroom, ample closet space, and secure safes.

One of the standout features of Casa Kameelya is its expansive outdoor area, which is quite rare for villas in this region. The exterior boasts a large, crystal-clear swimming pool, sunbathing spots, and spacious seating areas, all set within a generous garden that’s perfect for children to enjoy.

At the heart of the villa is a bright, airy living space with soaring ceilings that flow effortlessly into the poolside through sleek sliding doors, achieving a perfect harmony between indoor and outdoor living. For moments of privacy and coziness, the space can be enclosed with ease. Relax on the plush sofa and enjoy entertainment on the large smart TV with Netflix,  perfect for entertainment on rainy days. The room also features an elegant dining area, combining comfort with sophisticated style for a truly inviting experience.

Next to the living room is a well-equipped kitchen, ideal for cooking your own meals or arranging for a chef to cater to your culinary desires. Don’t hesitate to ask about our chef services to enhance your stay.

Conveniently located in the heart of Berawa, the villa is just a short walk from the beach and some of Bali’s trendiest cafes and restaurants. 

This villa is a true luxurious retreat for large groups or families looking to enjoy a memorable holiday on the island of the gods.

GUEST ACCESS
The whole villa with complete privacy.

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Villa staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guests
- High Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool Fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more! 

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

reviews.name: 萍萍
reviews.comment:
The villa's aesthetics are stunning at first glance. The high sloping roof and the large floor-to-ceiling glass windows create a sense of openness. The private pool is surrounded by tropical greenery. As soon as you walk into the yard, you are instantly enveloped by a relaxing holiday atmosphere. The view is full of greenery and clear pool water. Every photo you take is like an Instagram masterpiece.
The interior space is spacious and comfortable. The large sunken sofa in the living room is perfect for relaxing and lying down. The wooden roof is complemented by simple and elegant soft furnishings, creating a high-end and cozy feel. The dining and kitchen area is neat and functional. The host provides fruit and specially prepared drinks here. You can enjoy a drink and chat while enjoying the beautiful view of the pool. The atmosphere is great, and the privacy is also very well maintained. There is absolutely no need to worry about being disturbed. You wouldn't get tired of lying here all day.
The only minor drawback is that parking on the small road leading to the house is not particularly convenient. Otherwise, I really can't find any issues. The environment, design, comfort, and cleanliness are all impeccable. It's perfect for a relaxing holiday with friends and family. Next time I come, I will definitely choose this place again. Highly recommended for friends who want a slow-paced holiday!
reviews.originalComment:
别墅的颜值第一眼就被狠狠惊艳，挑高的斜顶+整面落地大玻璃，通透感直接拉满，热带绿植环绕私人泳池，走进院子瞬间就被满满的松弛度假感包围，满眼绿意+清透池水，拍照每一帧都像ins大片。
室内空间宽敞又舒适，下沉式大沙发客厅太适合放空躺卧，木质屋顶搭配简约侘寂风软装，质感高级又温馨；餐厨区域整洁好用，房东在这里备好水果和特调饮品，对着泳池美景小酌闲聊，氛围感直接拉满，私密性也做得非常好，完全不用担心被打扰。在这里躺上一整天都完全不会腻。
唯一小小的不足就是入户的小路停车不是特别方便，除此之外真的挑不出毛病，环境、设计、舒适度、整洁度都无可挑剔，太适合和朋友、家人一起来度假放松，下次来一定还会优先选择这里，强烈推荐给想要慢节奏度假的朋友们！

fullDesc:
Discover Villa Vaya, a stylish and luxurious villa just a few minutes away from Batu Belig Beach. It offers the ultimate Bali retreat.

What you can look forward to:

- Prime location, close to the beach and great restaurants 
- tropical and minimalist design
- Fully serviced

Villa Vaya is fully furnished and staffed, ensuring a worry-free stay for you!

THE SPACE
Villa Vaya, a stylishly designed three-bedroom villa, is centrally locate retreat between Canggu and Seminyak, where luxury meets tranquility amidst Bali's top cafes and restaurants.

The spaciousness of our villas is unparalleled, providing a large seating area with a comfortable sofa and expansive bay windows that flood the villa with natural light throughout the day. Whether you're lounging in the vast living room or indulging in the tranquility of private bedrooms and en-suite bathrooms, every corner is a testament to refined living. 

The highlight of the property is its stunning swimming pool, ideal for relaxing after a day of exploring. The outdoor area also boasts a seating area, perfect for enjoying the warm Bali sunshine with a poll view.

The fully equipped kitchen provides all necessary utensils and amenities for preparing meals, or guests can opt for the convenience of having meals prepared for them. A dedicated dining area allows for gatherings dinners.

For those seeking the pinnacle of luxury, Villa Vaya promise an unforgettable experience where every element is designed to exceed expectations.

GUEST ACCESS
The whole villa will be available for you with complete privacy.

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE
Included in every stay:
-Free welcome drink
-Villa staff with daily cleaning
-Bath towels for each guests
-Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
-Safety boxes
-Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:
-Airport transfer
-Car rental (with/without driver)
-Bike rental
-Breakfast upon request
-Massages at the villa
-Nanny services
-Pool Fence
-Laundry
-Restaurant bookings
-Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
-Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
-And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

fullDesc:
Escape to Halle, a peaceful haven in the tranquil Seseh area, just a short 100-meter walk to the beach.

What awaits you:

- Easy access to Seseh Beach and surrounding areas
- Stylish interiors and modern comforts
- Private pool and relaxing outdoor spaces

The villa is fully equipped and staffed so you can simply relax and enjoy your vacation.

THE SPACE
Discover to Villa Halle, a peaceful haven located just a steps from the beach. Imagine waking up to the soothing sounds of nature, stepping out onto your private terrace, and diving into a sparkling pool. This stylish 2-bedroom villa blends modern luxury with tropical charm, offering the perfect space for relaxation and rejuvenation.

As you enter, you’ll be welcomed by a private pool surrounded by comfortable sun loungers, inviting you to soak up the Bali sun. The open-plan living area features a cozy sunken sofa and a TV, seamlessly connecting to the dining and kitchen areas—ideal for socializing or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings. The fully equipped kitchen offers modern appliances, making meal preparation easy and convenient.

Each bedroom is a private retreat, designed with comfort in mind, featuring plush beds, air conditioning, and ensuite bathrooms for added convenience.

Whether you're looking for a tranquil getaway or a base to explore the best of Bali, Villa Halle combines luxury with the perfect location. Discover the charm of Seseh, with its pristine beaches, local cafes, and lush surroundings just moments away.

GUEST ACCESS
Complete access and total privacy.

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Daily housekeeping
- Bath towels for each guests
- High Speed Wifi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool Fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as water sports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages
- And much more! 

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villas!

*Please note that there is nearby construction work, which may occasionally cause noise disturbance. This is expected to continue until the end of January 2027.*

fullDesc:
Welcome to Yellow Moon, a private villa in the heart of Southern Bali, delightfully secluded yet just minutes away from breathtaking beaches like Melasti; vibrant beach clubs such as Savaya and Sunday's Beach Club; and a world-class golf course. Perfect for surfers, families or anyone seeking a peaceful Bali escape.

THE SPACE
Step inside Yellow Moon, a stunning 3-bedroom villa cocooned in lush greenery of the tropics—a sanctuary where Balinese artistry and natural beauty meet modern design and luxury. description: Nestled in Bingin, CASA KĀYA is a chic 1-bedroom retreat designed for couples seeking romance and relaxation in a stylish setting.
fullDesc:
Nestled in Bingin, CASA KĀYA is a chic 1-bedroom retreat designed for couples seeking romance and relaxation in a stylish setting.

This modern and elegantly styled villa, part of an exclusive residence, features open-plan living spaces and a stunning private pool as its serene centerpiece, surrounded by lush tropical greenery.

Located just a 3-minute ride from Dreamland Beach, it offers the perfect balance of privacy and access to Bali’s vibrant coastal life.

THE SPACE
**As with many popular areas in Bali, ongoing development is prevalent in Bingin. Please note that there is construction adjacent to and opposite the villa, which may result in daytime noise and potential privacy disturbances. This is expected to continue until the end of March 2027. However, to accommodate this inconvenience, our nightly rates have been significantly discounted**

CASA KĀYA is a brand-new 1-bedroom villa created for couples seeking style, comfort, and a touch of Bali magic. Just a 3-minute ride away from Dreamland Beach, cafés, and beach clubs this private hideaway blends modern design with tropical greenery for the ultimate retreat.

Wake up to garden views, enjoy a swim in your private pool, or unwind on the sunken sofa for a cozy movie night. With a fully equipped kitchen, dining area, and even a full bathroom, the villa is designed for both convenience and romance.

Upstairs, the airy bedroom with high ceilings and an ensuite bathroom offers a peaceful escape after days of exploring. With fast WiFi, Netflix, and seamless indoor-outdoor living, CASA KĀYA is the perfect setting for honeymoons, getaways, and everything in between.

📍 Nearby favorites:

- Dreamland Beach – 3 min
- Bingin Beach – 6 min
- Bambu Fitness – 5 min
- El Kabron – 3 min

Whether it’s beaches, sunsets, or Bali’s hidden gems, this villa is your private sanctuary to return to, wrapping every moment in style and serenity.

GUEST ACCESS
Guests have full and private access to the entire villa

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Villa’s staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guest
- High-speed Wi-Fi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as water sports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

fullDesc:
Welcome to Padang Senang, a fresh and stylish 3-bedroom villa perfectly positioned in the heart of Uluwatu. 
Just steps from trendy cafés (Ours Café is literally next door!) and only a 10-minute walk to Padang Padang Beach, this villa blends chic tropical design with relaxed island living. 
Whether you’re here to surf, unwind, or explore, this is your home for effortless Bali days.

THE SPACE
🏡 Outdoor Area & Pool

Step into your own private paradise. A sparkling 10 × 3 m terrazzo-style pool sits at the center of the villa, surrounded by lush greenery and calming sunlight. Lounge on the sunbeds, cool off under the outdoor shower, or enjoy a quiet moment on the shaded patio — the ultimate backdrop for slow mornings and sunset downtime.

🛋️ Living Room

Designed for comfort and connection, the sunken living area offers a cozy spot to gather, watch a movie, or simply relax after a day at the beach. With a soft U-shaped sofa and natural textures throughout, it’s the perfect blend of modern style and warm island charm.

🍽️ Kitchen & Dining

The open kitchen and dining space make shared meals feel easy and enjoyable. Prepare a relaxed breakfast, brew your morning coffee, or cook dinner together — the space is fully equipped for everyday comfort and long, leisurely dining.

🛏️ Bedrooms

Padang Senang features three spacious and serene bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom for total privacy:

- Ground-floor bedroom overlooking the pool — ideal for guests wanting easy access

- Two upstairs suites with calming natural light and stylish décor

- Master suite with rain shower and a luxurious bathtub for slow, indulgent evenings

Every room is designed with soothing tones, plush linens, and thoughtful details that invite you to unwind.

🛁 Bathrooms

All bathrooms are ensuite and designed with clean lines, warm textures, and spa-inspired touches. Enjoy rain showers, soft lighting, quality amenities, and a relaxing bathtub in the master bathroom.

📍 Neighborhood & Location

Stay in the center of everything Uluwatu is loved for:

* Padang Padang Beach — 10-minute walk

* Bingin Beach — 1.7 km

* Moments from favorite cafés & restaurants: Ours Uluwatu, Rolling Fork, The Place With No Name, Bartolo

* A short drive to iconic beach clubs: El Kabron, Ulu Cliffhouse, Savaya

* Supermarkets, surf shops, gyms, convenience stores — all within quick reach

Whether you're exploring, dining out, or soaking in Bali’s surf culture, everything is right outside your door.

🏋️‍♀️ Fitness & Wellness

If staying active is part of your Bali rhythm, you’ll love the selection of studios nearby:

* Bambu Fitness Bali

* Health Club Uluwatu

* 360 MOVE

* Ulu Active

* The Space Bali

From strength training to yoga and recovery, the area offers everything to keep your body balanced and energized.

Villa Padang Senang is more than a place to stay — it’s a thoughtfully designed retreat where style, comfort, and the best of Uluwatu come together. From its brand-new interiors to its unbeatable location, Padang Senang is your gateway to beach days, good coffee, world-class surf, and unforgettable Bali memories.

GUEST ACCESS
Guests have full and exclusive access to the entire villa during their stay.

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Daily cleaning keeps the villa fresh and welcoming
- Pool & garden maintenance 2–3x/week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guests
- High-speed Wi-Fi for streaming and working
- Safety boxes for peace of mind
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as water sports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at Padang Senang!

reviews.comment:
We had a great stay and would happily recommend this villa.
The property itself is very new, modern, clean and well appointed, with all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay. The hosts were exceptionally responsive, friendly and easy to communicate with throughout our visit.
A particularly thoughtful touch was the lovely birthday greeting they arranged during my stay, which was greatly appreciated.

Overall, the quality of the accommodation, the responsiveness of the hosts and the standard of the villa itself made for a very enjoyable stay. Thank you again.

description: Welcome to TĀRA Bingin Villa, a stylish new two-bedroom retreat in the exclusive Blacksand Villas Bingin, perfectly located just minutes from the beach, cafés, and restaurants.
fullDesc:
Welcome to TĀRA Bingin Villa, a stylish new two-bedroom retreat in the exclusive Blacksand Villas Bingin, perfectly located just minutes from the beach, cafés, and restaurants.

Enjoy a private pool, open living spaces, and a beautifully private terrace upstairs, complete with comfortable seating and an airy pergola for all-day relaxation.

Ideal for friends or families seeking privacy, style, and a prime location near Bali’s beaches and sunsets.

THE SPACE
**As with many popular areas in Bali, ongoing development is prevalent in Bingin. Please note that there is construction adjacent to and opposite the villa, which may result in daytime noise and potential privacy disturbances. This is expected to continue until the end of December. However, to accommodate this inconvenience, our nightly rates have been significantly discounted

Experience to TĀRA Bingin Villa, your stylish tropical hideaway just minutes from Bingin and Dreamland Beach. Perfect for a relaxed Bali escape, this brand-new 2-bedroom villa blends comfort, privacy, and effortless holiday vibes!

Start your mornings with a refreshing dip in your private pool surrounded by lush greenery, then ease into the day with a slow breakfast in the open living area. In the evenings, curl up for a cozy movie night and let the calm of the villa settle in.

Designed with comfort and style in mind, each bedroom features a king-size bed, a contemporary ensuite bathroom, and a dedicated TV for relaxed downtime. The open-plan kitchen and dining area provide everything you need for convenient at-home dining, complemented by modern finishes, wood, stone, and subtle tropical touches, that bring a premium, serene feel to the space.

Next to the upstairs bedroom, the private terrace awaits, thoughtfully designed for lounging and social moments, with comfortable seating, tropical accents, and an airy pergola, perfect for relaxing throughout the day.

With generous bedroom spaces, fast WiFi, Netflix, and seamless indoor–outdoor living, TĀRA Bingin Villa offers the ideal blend of comfort and style, perfect for friends, couples, or families looking to relax in the heart of Bali’s most iconic surf area.

📍 Location & Nearby Attractions
Nestled within the exclusive Blacksand Villas Bingin complex, the villa places some of Bali’s top spots right at your doorstep:

- Dreamland Beach – 3 min
- Bingin Beach – 6 min
- Bambu Fitness – 5 min
- El Kabron – 3 min

After sun-soaked beach days, sunset sessions, café hopping, or exploring Bali’s hidden gems, return to your private sanctuary and let TĀRA Bingin Villa welcome you back with comfort, style, and tropical serenity.

GUEST ACCESS
Guests have full and private access to the entire villa.

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Villa’s staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guest
- High-speed Wi-Fi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as water sports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay!

description: Located in Umalas just minutes from Berawa, Villa Ithaki is a striking five bedroom residence set on a generous ten are estate.
fullDesc:
Located in Umalas just minutes from Berawa, Villa Ithaki is a striking five bedroom residence set on a generous ten are estate.

This thoughtfully designed retreat blends bold architecture with elevated comfort, offering a private pool, sauna, ice bath, dedicated spa room, TV corner, workspace, and an elegant bar for effortless entertaining.

Ithaki delivers a refined Bali experience where luxury, tranquility, and modern living come together in perfect harmony.

THE SPACE
Welcome to Villa Ithaki, a five-bedroom architectural hideaway set on a generous ten are in the peaceful, sought-after Umalas area. The villa brings together bold contemporary design, high-end comfort, and the calm rhythm of Bali’s tropical landscape in one seamless experience.

From the moment you enter, the atmosphere sets the tone. Push open the door and you’re greeted by stone walkways floating over koi ponds, with the soft echo of moving water around you. Ahead, a long stretch of manicured greenery pulls you deeper into the estate, building anticipation as the villa quietly reveals itself.

The main pavilion opens into a bright, expansive living area where natural light pours in from all sides. Views of the shimmering pool and lush surroundings anchor the space in tranquility. High ceilings, curated décor, and warm textures create a balance of sophistication and ease. To one side sits a fully equipped modern kitchen ideal for private dining or chef service, while the opposite end features a custom bar that naturally becomes the evening gathering spot.

Outside, the pool is the villa’s centerpiece. Framed by tropical plants, plush daybeds, and open sky, it’s designed for long, unhurried afternoons. A dedicated wellness wing enhances the sense of retreat, complete with a private massage room and a traditional sauna tucked away for quiet restoration.

The five bedrooms each offer comfort and thoughtful design:

• Primary Suite: King bed, two walk-in wardrobes, and a TV discreetly concealed in the bed frame, plus an en suite bathroom.
• Second Suite: Another king bed with generous space and an elegant en suite.
• Third Bedroom: Queen bed paired with a refined en suite.
• Fourth & Fifth Bedrooms: A family-friendly setup—one with a small double bed, the other with a single—linked by a shared bathroom with a bathtub ideal for kids.
• Children’s Playroom: A dedicated space for younger guests.

Just minutes from Berawa’s top restaurants, cafés, boutiques, and beach clubs, Villa Ithaki combines modern luxury with easy access to one of Bali’s most dynamic neighborhoods—an ideal choice for travelers seeking both elegance and connection to the island’s vibrant scene.

GUEST ACCESS
Guests have full and private access to the entire villa

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE
Included in every stay:
-Cleaning is provided everyday (except on Sunday). If you have a preferred time, please let your villa manager know in advance. Cleaning typically occurs between 10 AM and 5 PM, and exact times depend on the manager's schedule.
- Free welcome drink
-Bath towels for each guest
-Hi-Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
-Safety boxes
-Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:
-Airport transfer
-Car rental (with/without driver)
-Bike rental
-Breakfast upon request
-Private cook
-Massages at the villa
-Nanny services
-Pool Fence
-Laundry
-Restaurant bookings
-Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
-Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
-And much more!


Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

***Please note that there is construction work near the villa, which may cause some disturbing noise. This is expected to continue until the end of December 2026***
